svg.title: Night Shift — five stops, one delivery
svg.desc: An original black-and-yellow freight wagon stays at the center as a long night city scrolls past. Five widely separated loading stations place five cubes in the wagon. A larger dispatch terminal receives the cargo, and the empty wagon continues toward another sprint. A 60-second decorative loop, not GitHub activity data. Reduced motion shows a still at the third loading stop.

g.text: A LITTLE PROGRESS AT EVERY STOP.
